title: Perfect telescope computing sections on an etale chart
statement:
Work over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ with schemes [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], canonical tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], and derived functors computed by K-flat and K-injective resolutions. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ for the full subcategory with quasi-coherent cohomology. Perfect means etale locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finitely presented, and let $u:U\to X$ be an etale morphism with $U$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme. Finite presentation here means quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally finitely presented on etale scheme charts. There is a sequence of perfect objects $E_m\to E_{m+1}$ in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ and compatible maps $e_m:E_m\to Ru_*\mathcal O_U$ whose sequential homotopy colimit is $Ru_*\mathcal O_U$. Homotopy colimit has the telescope-triangle meaning of [def-kun-truncations]; all sequences and coproducts are small. For every $L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ the maps
$$\theta_{m,L}:R\Gamma(X,E_m\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}L)\longrightarrow R\Gamma(U,u^*L)$$
obtained from $e_m\otimes1$, the canonical projection formula $Ru_*\mathcal O_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\to Ru_*u^*L$, and derived composition induce an isomorphism
$$\operatorname{hocolim}_mR\Gamma(X,E_m\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(U,u^*L)$$
in $D(A)$, natural in every morphism of $L$. The same sequence and the same maps give this isomorphism in $D(B)$ for every commutative $A$-algebra $B$ and every complex $L$ of $\mathcal O_X\otimes_A B$-modules whose underlying $\mathcal O_X$-complex has quasi-coherent cohomology; here $E_m\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L$ is formed using K-flat representatives of $E_m$, retaining the $B$-action. These maps and isomorphisms are natural for $B$-linear morphisms, and their underlying $D(A)$ maps are the displayed ones. Homotopy colimits of these diagrams and their maps are computed by mapping telescopes on compatible complex representatives; the naturality just asserted holds for these diagram maps, not merely for the individual legs of an arbitrarily chosen cone.

proof.text: Put $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $F=Ru_*\mathcal O_U$. The affine base is qcqs, so [lem-sfb-space-fp-qcqs-source] makes $X$ qcqs. By [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-permanence], $u$ is qcqs, since its source is qcqs and its target is quasi-separated. The etale chart definition [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-weil-etale-morphism] makes $u$ flat and locally finitely presented on scheme charts, hence finitely presented. Thus $U\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is finitely presented by composition [lem-sfb-space-separated-fp-composition], without asserting that $U$ is separated. Finally [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-coproducts] gives $F\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: 0CRW proof: finiteness hypotheses for approximation and direct image.

proof.text: Express $A$ as the filtered union of its finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-subalgebras $A_i$: every finite set lies in the subalgebra it generates, so the index set is small and directed. Apply [lem-sfb-fp-space-limit-category] first to $X/ A$, obtaining $X_i/A_i$ finitely presented. Its base changes $X_j$ are qcqs by [lem-sfb-space-fp-qcqs-source]. The projections $X_j\to X_i$ are affine because an affine test $\operatorname{Spec}C\to X_i$ pulls them back to $\operatorname{Spec}(C\otimes_{A_i}A_j)$ (the ring-map tensor universal property), and $X=\varprojlim X_j$ by the fibre-product universal property. Apply [lem-sfb-space-fp-over-space-limit-descent] to the finitely presented object $U\to X$, giving $f_i:U_i\to X_i$ finitely presented. Both spaces are qcqs, again by [lem-sfb-space-fp-qcqs-source]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-etaleness-eventual-stage] to this arrow over the affine base system: its limit $u$ is etale, so after increasing $i$ the arrow $f_i$ is etale, hence flat [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Composition makes $U_i$ finitely presented over $A_i$. Neither descended space needs to be a scheme.

source.place: 0CRW proof, approximation paragraph; spaces-limits.tex Tag 07SL descends etaleness, supplying the required flatness since the limiting arrow here is etale.

proof.text: The ring $A_i$ is a finitely generated algebra over the Noetherian ring $\mathbf Z$, hence finitely presented [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-noetherian-finite-presentation]; by composition [lem-sfb-space-separated-fp-composition] $X_i$ and $U_i$ are finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$. Every affine etale scheme over either space is quasi-compact and separated over that space by [lem-sfb-space-affine-source-qc-separated]; etaleness gives local finite presentation [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Composition therefore makes this affine scheme finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$ [lem-sfb-space-separated-fp-composition]. Its ring is a quotient of a polynomial ring in finitely many variables over $\mathbf Z$, so is countable (finite tuples of integer coefficients and exponents form a countable set). Let $F_i=Rf_{i,*}\mathcal O_{U_i}$, which has quasi-coherent cohomology by [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-coproducts]. For an affine etale $V\to X_i$, [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus] identifies $F_i|_V$ with $R(f_i)_V{}_*(\mathcal O_{U_i\times_{X_i}V})$. Derived sections, their composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] and [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-module-realization] identify $\mathcal H^r(F_i)(V)$ with $H^rR\Gamma(U_i\times_{X_i}V,\mathcal O)$. The projection $U_i\times_{X_i}V\to U_i$ is etale and qcqs: $V\to X_i$ is qcqs and these properties survive base change [lem-sfb-space-quasicompact-fppf-local, lem-sfb-space-quasiseparated-test-calculus]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-countable-hypercohomology] to $K=P=\mathcal O_{U_i}$. It makes these groups countable. The countability criterion [lem-sfb-space-countable-telescope] now gives a perfect sequence $P_m$ with telescope $F_i$ and its compatible legs.

Let $g:X\to X_i$ be the base projection. Flat base change [lem-sfb-flat-space-derived-pushforward-base-change] gives the canonical isomorphism $Lg^*F_i\simeq F$, since $f_i$ is flat and qcqs. Set $E_m=Lg^*P_m$ and take $e_m$ to be $Lg^*$ of the telescope legs followed by this isomorphism. Pullback preserves perfectness [lem-sfb-space-perfect-limit-category]. Each $P_m$ lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X_i})$ by [lem-sfb-space-countable-telescope], and pullback preserves quasi-coherent cohomology [lem-sfb-space-derived-qcoh-pullback-tensor], so $E_m\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Its exactness and its derived adjunction to direct image are [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback, lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus]; a left adjoint preserves coproducts [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits]. Hence [lem-kun-functor-preserves-hocolim] carries the supplied telescope triangle to a telescope triangle with vertex $F$ and legs $e_m$.

source.place: 0CRW proof, pullback of the perfect telescope.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-ringed-augmented-sequence-model] for this supplied telescope. It gives a compatible K-flat sequence and a fixed telescope isomorphism to $F$, and identifies its tensor telescope with $F\otimes^{\mathbf L}L$, naturally in $L$. All its terms have quasi-coherent cohomology [lem-sfb-space-derived-qcoh-pullback-tensor]. The functor $R\Gamma(X,-)$ preserves small sums on this subcategory: apply [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-coproducts] to $a$ and then the affine equivalence [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-module-realization]. Derived composition is [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], and exactness is [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. Thus [lem-kun-functor-preserves-hocolim] identifies the section telescope with $R\Gamma(X,F\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)$. Finally apply the specified adjunction-mate isomorphism [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-derived-projection-formula] to $u$ and $\mathcal O_U$, and derived composition. Since etale pullback is exact [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus], its target is $R\Gamma(U,u^*L)$. The restriction to the $m$th telescope leg is precisely $R\Gamma(e_m\otimes1)$ followed by that projection mate and composition. These are the asserted $\theta_{m,L}$.

source.place: 0CRW proof, first paragraph; normalized projection map from 08IN.

proof.text: For $B$ and $L$ as in the statement put $\mathcal O_{Z,B}=\mathcal O_Z\otimes_A B$, for $Z=X,U$, and let $u_B$ denote $u$ with these rings. The sequence-model comparison [lem-sfb-ringed-augmented-sequence-model] is $B$-linear on complex diagrams. Etale pullback is exact slice restriction [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus], also for these coefficient rings. The derived adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], applied to $u_B$, transposes the following coefficient-linear map into $F\otimes^\mathbf L_{\mathcal O_X}L\to Ru_{B,*}u_B^*L$: pull back, identify the result with $u^*F\otimes^\mathbf L_{\mathcal O_U}u_B^*L$, and tensor the original counit $u^*F\to\mathcal O_U$ with $1$. The tensor identification is termwise slice restriction on the chosen K-flat representatives; $B$ acts on the second factor throughout. Apply coefficient derived sections. For a singleton index, [lem-pur-diagram-ring-restriction-pushforward] identifies these sections and direct images after forgetting coefficients with the original derived functors. Its normalization by ringed-topos composition identifies the underlying mate with [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-derived-projection-formula]: both transpose the same counit-tensor map, using slice restriction and K-injective resolutions. This constructs the asserted telescope map in $D(B)$.

source.place: 0CRW tensor construction with commuting coefficient action; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E for normalized scalar restriction.

proof.text: By scalar restriction [lem-pur-diagram-ring-restriction-pushforward] and normalized composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], the map in step 6 forgets to the isomorphism of step 5. Exact restriction of scalars detects quasi-isomorphisms: kernels and images of a $B$-linear differential have the same underlying $A$-modules. Apply this to a cone to see that restriction detects derived isomorphisms. The map is therefore an isomorphism in $D(B)$. Naturality holds before forgetting coefficients: the tensor telescope is natural on chain maps and roofs [lem-sfb-ringed-augmented-sequence-model], the counit-tensor adjunction construction is natural [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], and derived composition is natural [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Hence it holds for every $B$-linear derived morphism of $L$, including the $A$-linear case $B=A$. We used these diagram maps throughout; agreement of legs alone would not prove equality of arbitrary cone maps.
